name: cGZMessageServer::MessageSend
notes: Lane KU. Applies pending changes, then under the lock collects the targets registered for the message's id (AddRef each) into a fixed array, unlocks, delivers (DoMessage then Release each) and replays changes made meanwhile. ORIGINAL-BUG: the original's array has no bound; ours stops at 383 (the test keeps every id at or below it, and tests 381-383). GZMessageServer_Run with re-entrant DoMessage/AddRef/Release. Mutants killed except one argued equivalent (unlocking before the depth decrement: only another thread sees the difference).

name: cGZMessageServer::MessagePost
notes: Lane KU. Urgent messages go to the queue's front, others to the back. GZMessageServer_Run, both kinds. Mutant (urgent inverted): killed.

name: cGZMessageServer::AddNotification
notes: Lane KU. While a send is collecting, the change is queued (target AddRef'd); otherwise the target is appended to the id's list (a new list for a new id) and AddRef'd unless already present. ORIGINAL-BUG: a queued add of a target that is already registered keeps its AddRef (leak), reproduced. GZMessageServer_Run, direct and re-entrant. Mutants killed except one argued equivalent (push_front into a new one-element list).

name: cGZMessageServer::RemoveNotification
notes: Lane KU. Queued while a send collects; otherwise the target is removed from the id's list (Release) and an emptied list is freed. GZMessageServer_Run, direct and re-entrant, including unregistered targets. Mutants killed.

name: cGZMessageServer::GeneralMessagePostToTarget
notes: Lane KU. Appends (target, message copy) to the general posts under the general lock and returns the lock's Unlock result (non-zero when the caller already held it: the test holds it on every third call). Mutants (push_front, ignoring the Unlock result): killed.

name: cGZMessageServer::CancelGeneralMessagePostsToTarget
notes: Lane KU. Erases the target's general posts with erase(it++) on a deque: ORIGINAL-BUG reproduced, when the erase moves the back side the next post is skipped, and erasing the last element walks past the end (the test simulates each cancel and skips the unsafe ones). Returns the general lock's Unlock result (tested with the lock held). Mutants (the skip rule, the move-side rule, the return): killed after the lock-hold was added.

name: cGZMessageServer::ProcessPendingChanges
notes: Lane KU. Called only by our sends and notifications at depth 0: replays the pending changes through the virtual AddNotification / RemoveNotification under the static guard 0x1103248 (the game's own static, shared by both sides), popping each. Mutants killed except one argued equivalent (dropping the guard check: only reached at depth 0 under the lock, where the guard is never set).
